cluster.Build.description: Build is the build block of an Image.

args.description:
Args are the Dockerfile's ARG values, as Docker Compose's build.args:
--build-arg NAME=VALUE, in name order.

context.description: Context is the build context directory.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile is the Dockerfile path. Defaults to "Dockerfile".

target.description: Target is the stage of a multi-stage Dockerfile to build: --target.

anyOf.description: EnvFiles are .env file paths: one, or a list.

cluster.EnvFiles.description: EnvFiles are .env file paths: one, or a list.

cluster.Git.description: Git is where an image's build comes from: a remote repository, cloned, or a local one, used as it is or at a branch or ref.

branch.description:
Branch or Ref picks what to build; neither is the default branch
(remote) or the working tree as it is (local).

pull.description:
Pull says when a remote clone is fetched: Always (the default: every
run, so a branch is its latest commit) or IfNotPresent (a cached
clone is used as it is). A local repository is never pulled.

url.description:
URL is a remote repository (https://…, git@host:org/repo.git) or a
local path to one.

cluster.Healthcheck.description: Healthcheck is one check, written as Docker Compose writes it, and the Kubernetes probes it becomes.

as.description: As names the probes this check becomes. Default: [readiness].

interval.description: Interval, Timeout, Retries and StartPeriod are Compose's fields.

test.description:
Test is the check, as Compose writes it: ["CMD", ...] or
["CMD-SHELL", "..."]. A CMD form that is a single HTTP GET is
translated to httpGet; anything else is translated to exec.

cluster.Healthchecks.description: Healthchecks is an image's health check: one check for the probes its as names (the flat form), or one check per probe (the named form), not both.

as.description: As names the probes this check becomes. Default: [readiness].

interval.description: Interval, Timeout, Retries and StartPeriod are Compose's fields.

readiness.description: Named form: one check per probe.

test.description:
Test is the check, as Compose writes it: ["CMD", ...] or
["CMD-SHELL", "..."]. A CMD form that is a single HTTP GET is
translated to httpGet; anything else is translated to exec.

cluster.Image.description: Image is one entry in Images.

build.description: Build, when set, builds the image before loading it.

deploy.description:
Deploy, when set, deploys this image as a Kubernetes Deployment
and exposes it through a ClusterIP Service.

forEach.description:
ForEach repeats the entry once per row (Images.ExpandForEach): until
then its other values are templates that read .item, kept as written.

git.description:
Git is the repository the build comes from: build.context and
dockerfile resolve inside its checkout. Without it, they resolve
from the file that declares the image.

image.description:
Image is the reference the entry loads or deploys.
For a build, it is also the reference the build produces.
Defaults to jig-<name>-<index> or jig-image-<index> when omitted on a build.

include.description:
Include names a file whose images replace this entry, with their
build paths resolved from that file. It stands alone: an entry with
include sets nothing else. The caller expands it before using the list.

name.description:
Name is how other images' needs refer to this one. Defaults to its
Deployment's name.

needs.description:
Needs are the images this one's Deployment comes after: each is
deployed and ready first, as GitHub Actions jobs need others.

cluster.ImageDeploy.description: ImageDeploy configures a Kubernetes Deployment and Service for an image.

env.description:
Env are the container's environment variables, as Compose's
environment: the caller resolves their values before deploying.

envFile.description:
EnvFile are .env files, as Compose's env_file: their variables become
a Secret (<name>-env), loaded with envFrom; a later file wins.

envFrom.description:
EnvFrom are Secrets the container loads whole, each key a variable,
in the Deployment's namespace.

healthcheck.description:
Healthcheck is the container's check, as Docker Compose writes it,
and the probes it becomes.

init.description:
Init are containers run to completion, in order, before the app's
starts: Kubernetes' initContainers, in the same pod (its network, its
env), for what Compose does with a separate service and depends_on
(a migration, waiting for a dependency).

name.description:
Name is the Deployment and Service name.
Defaults to the image name without its tag or digest.

namespace.description:
Namespace is the target namespace.
Defaults to "default".

ports.description:
Ports are the container's ports, each with a Service port and a
forward to localhost (Port). At least one. TCP is used.

replicas.description:
Replicas is the desired number of Deployment replicas.
Defaults to 1.

cluster.Images.description: Images is the ordered list of container images a run loads into the cluster.

cluster.InitContainer.description: InitContainer is one entry in deploy.init.

command.description:
Command must exit: an init that runs an app's entrypoint never
finishes, and the pod never starts.

env.description:
Env, EnvFrom and EnvFile are as the app's container has them; an
init's EnvFile is a Secret of its own (<name>-<init>-env).

image.description:
Image defaults to the app's image. It is a reference: an image built
by an images entry, or one the cluster pulls; never built here.

name.description: Name is the container's name. Defaults to init-<index>.

anyOf.description: The container port, forwarded on the same localhost port
Port is one entry in deploy.ports.

expose.description:
Expose reports whether the Service has this port. Default true; false
is a container port only: no Service port, no forward.

forward.description:
Forward reports whether jig forwards this port to localhost. Default
true. Set false for a port reachable in-cluster but not needed on the
developer's machine.

host.description:
Host is the localhost port the forward listens on. Defaults to Port
when omitted.

port.description:
Port is the container port. The Service targets it, and the
Deployment's containerPort is it.

cluster.Port.description: Port is one entry in deploy.ports.

cluster.Probes.description: Probes is the set of Kubernetes probes a healthcheck becomes.

spec.ImagesInclude.description: ImagesInclude is the file an include: entry in an images list names.
